default_policy.review_rule: GitHub discovery, preview retrieval, and README evidence use fixed HTTPS GitHub host allowlists, timeouts, and response-size limits. Search results are candidates only and require a matching remote SKILL.md before association.

scripts\\github_discovery.py.purpose: Generate exact-name GitHub candidates for family-primary Skills that lack repository metadata, then verify repository state, a matching SKILL.md path, content similarity, and local author evidence before binding a unique high-confidence result.
scripts\\github_discovery.py.redirect_policy: HTTPS redirects are accepted only when the destination remains on the fixed GitHub host allowlist.
scripts\\github_discovery.py.auth: optional existing GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN or GitHub CLI login read at runtime; never persisted

scripts\\github_preview.py.purpose: Read an observed public GitHub repository page and cache one verified preview image for the local catalog.
scripts\\github_preview.py.custom_url_policy: not supported; repository pages must be github.com URLs already observed in scanned metadata

scripts\\description_queue.py.purpose: Read a bounded README excerpt for an observed public GitHub repository while preparing an Agent-owned description batch.
scripts\\description_queue.py.custom_url_policy: not supported; repository URLs must already be observed in the catalog queue
